description: SiteTrax.io is a logistics operations analytics app for authorized teams. Search shared projects and yards, inspect container and supply chain equipment detections, review camera health and anomalies, analyze videos and images, retrieve audit feedback, and run server-side analytics for status, volume, activity, and sequence metrics. Look up SiteTrax.io logistics definitions and fetch research-ready reports including labor efficiency, revenue, and cost reduction opportunities. Create confirmed email alerts and scheduled digests for matching detections.

defaultPrompt: Give me a summary of yesterday's gate activity.
Create a confirmed daily SiteTrax.io email digest for new container detections matching one of my shared projects.
Analyze container activity across my shared yards this week, including volume, status, dwell, and sequence trends.
